dct_description_sm: The original Microsoft Excel workbook (SwantonMcKenzieGopsill_allData) is presented in full and as individual Comma Values Separated spreadsheets for long-term access and preservation purposes.

This dataset contains the laboratory research data for all bioassays reported in the manuscript entitled, "Early physiological and biochemical responses of soyabean to neighbouring weeds under resource-independent competition" (see Related Publication).

This data was collected as part of Andrew McKenzie-Gopsill's PhD research work (see Related Publication).
